aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab’s software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, pick-up times, fewer repetitive questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We make practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile caterers, to help them take online orders, manage pick-up times, keep orders flowing smoothly and cut the time spent on repetitive questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was made to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: But most of the software available to them was made for businesses with a permanent address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses really work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab began with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After I made Village Foodie, a directory that helps people find the food trucks visiting their area, I studied more of the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are always moving, trading at different places and serving customers in changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see pick-up times your kitchen can really manage. It is based on each dish’s prep time and how many you prepare at once.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system stop my kitchen from being overloaded?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also have Stripe fees: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.costTrial: The first {months, plural, one {# month is} other {# months are}} free, including every feature.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and day you are there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with different places?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported for now.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum term and no notice period. You can cancel any time; the fee is billed monthly in advance, and you have access until the end of the month you paid for.
comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a POS and has no TSE. How you record online orders in your POS — ask your tax adviser that.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a POS with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers even reach the truck: they choose food and a pick-up time, pay online or at pick-up, and the order appears in your kitchen. A POS or card reader takes payment at the truck. The two work together.

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year, ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a later date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm them one by one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Put your logo on your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Give an order a buzzer number when you hand out a buzzer, so you know which buzzer is for which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see, showing order numbers and when they’re ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your truck appears on HatchGrab’s public map so customers near you can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Save your certificates in one place, such as food safety, insurance and gas safety. We’ll remind you before anything expires, and you can send them to the event or market organiser in one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one links straight to its order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen display (KDS), and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at the same time and how long it takes. Once a slot is full, customers can no longer pick it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward your regulars with digital stamp cards — collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into combo meals and offer add-ons at checkout to raise the average order.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like WhatsApp auto-replies, for questions on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the front counter and in the kitchen — all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own login with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: When you lose signal, online ordering pauses so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. With the iPhone, iPad and Android app you keep taking orders even offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Have customers pay by card first when they order online, using Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a cut-off time for items that need to be ordered in advance.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t appear on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter the cost of each dish and see how much you really earned at each event, not just your sales.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website, or the photo you already post on Facebook. You just review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Text customers automatically when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add your dates, places and times for each week and event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item sold out in one tap — it turns grey for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock count and it goes down as orders come in, then it becomes sold out by itself.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, so you no longer need a separate card reader.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets to a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers pick a pick-up time from the time slots, so the volume of orders is spread across your whole service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the truck, paid on your own card reader.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: WhatsApp auto-reply to questions about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at the same time, and how long it takes. Once a pick-up time is full, customers can no longer pick it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the van — and the card reader you already use to take payment.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems rely on a permanent address, good Wi-Fi and the same hours every week. You: your place differs each week, the times differ, and the signal is weak or absent. HatchGrab was made for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: When you lose signal, online ordering pauses automatically so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. You keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We’ll fill in your dates, places and times, ready to share — weekly or daily.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your Facebook and Instagram posts
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers pre-order and pick a pick-up time. Fewer queues, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Made for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp gets answered while you drive to the pitch or are at the grill, using your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
